_producer_notes: Each per-mode JSON wraps {mode, generated_at, stats, deep_dive, quick_skim, ...}. Items inside deep_dive / quick_skim carry {id, paper_id?, title, abstract, link, tags, llm_score, ...} — the canonical id field is 'id', not 'arxiv_id'. 'reason' is not a guaranteed field on each entry (only certain carryover paths include it); we only require the minimum shape the producer always emits.
